extName.description: Extension name shown in Web Store and browser

extDesc.message: 將你在網頁上發現的內容連同圖片、文字、作者和來源，一起儲存到電腦上可搜尋的資料庫。以隱私為優先的設計。
extDesc.description: Extension description shown in Web Store

actionInjectUnreadable.message: Hologram：無法開始儲存——擴充功能無法讀取自己的檔案。請在 chrome://extensions 重新載入。
actionInjectUnreadable.description: Toolbar tooltip when the extension's own files can no longer be read, so injecting the capture UI fails on every page

actionInjectRefused.message: Hologram：無法在此頁面開始儲存
actionInjectRefused.description: Toolbar tooltip when the extension is healthy but this particular page refused the injection

cmdActivateAuto.message: 開始自動擷取（X 書籤清單）
cmdActivateAuto.description: Keyboard command description (Alt+Shift+S) for the auto capture mode

optionsLede.message: 設定儲存功能在你瀏覽的時間軸中的顯示方式。已儲存的內容請在 Hologram 應用程式中管理。

optionsSavedBadge.description: Options group label for the timeline saved-post mark

optionsSavedBadgeDesc.message: 在時間軸中已存在於 Hologram 資料庫的圖片上顯示小標記。檢查只會在這台電腦上進行。
optionsSavedBadgeDesc.description: Options description for the timeline saved-post mark

optionsSavedBadgeHover.description: Options choice: show the saved mark only while pointing at the post

optionsSavedBadgeAlways.description: Options choice: show the saved mark whenever the post is on screen

optionsSavedBadgeOff.description: Options choice: never show the saved mark

optionsHoverSave.message: 游標指向圖片時顯示儲存按鈕
optionsHoverSave.description: Options label for the hover save button

optionsHoverSaveDesc.message: 在尚未儲存的圖片上顯示儲存按鈕。它會儲存圖片本身，以及貼文的文字、作者和來源網址。若要儲存貼文外觀的螢幕擷取畫面，請改用 Alt+S 貼文擷取。
optionsHoverSaveDesc.description: Options description for the hover save button, including what it does NOT save

optionsDuplicateWarning.description: Options label for the duplicate-save warning

optionsDuplicateWarningDesc.message: 儲存資料庫中已有的圖片時，詢問要複製、取代或略過。同一貼文的另一張圖片（例如漫畫的下一頁）不算重複，因此不會詢問。如果正在儲存的貼文位於資料庫的垃圾桶中，也會提醒你。關閉此設定也會關閉該提醒。
optionsDuplicateWarningDesc.description: Options description for the duplicate-save warning, including when it does NOT ask

ctxBookmark.description: Context menu item: bookmark the current page (#195)

popupSave.description: Popup primary button: start capturing the post on the active tab

popupSaveProfile.description: Popup item: save the profile on the active tab as a poster

popupSaveProfileFailed.description: Popup reason: saving the active profile failed

popupSaveHint.description: Popup hint pointing frequent savers at the one-press keyboard route, shown only when one is actually assigned (#851)

popupBulk.description: Popup item (#793): start bulk-intake (chase-mode) on the active tab's list

popupBulkHint.description: Popup hint pointing at the bulk-intake keyboard shortcut, shown only when one is actually assigned (#793)

popupBulkUnsupported.message: 此頁面沒有可批次匯入的清單
popupBulkUnsupported.description: Popup reason: the active tab has no list the bulk-intake mode can walk (#793)

popupRefusedNotHttp.message: 此頁面沒有可儲存的內容——請先開啟網頁。
popupRefusedNotHttp.description: Popup reason: the active tab is not an http(s) page, so nothing can be injected into it

popupRefusedNoTab.message: 找不到可供儲存的分頁。
popupRefusedNoTab.description: Popup reason: no active tab could be found

popupRefusedPage.message: 無法在此頁面開始儲存。通常是頁面本身的限制所致。
popupRefusedPage.description: Popup reason: the extension is healthy and this page refused the injection

popupRefusedUnreadable.message: 擴充功能無法讀取自己的檔案。請在 chrome://extensions 重新載入。
popupRefusedUnreadable.description: Popup reason: the extension's own files can no longer be read

popupOpenExtensions.description: Popup button that opens chrome://extensions filtered to this extension

popupOpenDiag.description: Popup link/button that opens the diagnostics page

popupOpenOptions.description: Popup link that opens the settings page

popupStatusChecking.description: Popup connection row while the native-host ping is still in flight

popupStatusConnected.message: 已連線至 Hologram 應用程式
popupStatusConnected.description: Popup connection row: the native host answered and both halves match

popupStatusDisconnected.message: 未連線至 Hologram 應用程式
popupStatusDisconnected.description: Popup connection row: the native host did not answer

popupStatusHostOld.message: Hologram 應用程式版本過舊。請更新應用程式。
popupStatusHostOld.description: Popup connection row: the host is older than this extension (#205)

popupStatusExtensionOld.message: 此擴充功能版本過舊。請更新擴充功能。
popupStatusExtensionOld.description: Popup connection row: this extension is older than the host (#205)

popupHostNotRegistered.message: 儲存元件尚未註冊——需要安裝 Hologram 應用程式。
popupHostNotRegistered.description: Popup connection detail: Chrome could not find the native messaging host's registration

popupHostNoAnswer.description: Popup connection detail: the host was launched but did not answer in time

popupHostDisconnected.description: Popup connection detail: the host process ended before answering

popupHostRejected.message: 此擴充功能不允許連線——重新安裝 Hologram 應用程式可解決此問題。
popupHostRejected.description: Popup connection detail: the host refused this extension's origin

popupQueued.message: $COUNT$ 個儲存項目正在等待重新傳送
popupQueued.description: Popup row: saves stashed in the retry queue while the host was unreachable (#203)

popupToday.description: Popup row: how many saves landed today

popupHistoryTitle.description: Popup section heading above the recent-saves list

popupHistoryEmpty.description: Popup recent-saves list when nothing has been saved yet

popupRunCount.description: Popup recent-saves row: how many saves one folded bulk-intake run stands for

popupSaveFailed.description: Popup recent-saves row mark for a save that did not land
